## Requirements
- R1 LinkML ontology: every §11 entity (23) + §12 edge (~30), incl [NEW] entities. SIG-ONTO-*.
- R2 §13 vocabularies as SKOS: technology 14/36/104; capability ~45; evidence/epistemics; 4 lifecycle tracks; org/evidence/acquisition/role enums; predicates. i18n (BCP-47, country namespacing).
- R3 predicate registry: volatility+strategy+directness per predicate. SIG-ONTO-066/067.
- R4 generators: SQL DDL, JSON Schema, OWL/SHACL, Pydantic, docs. SIG-STORE-034.
- R5 generalization conformance suite tests/ontology/generalization/. SIG-CHART-028.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1 verify-gen: committed generated == fresh generation.
- AC2 Generalization suite: acoustic sensor; capability no asset; reference database; commercial data-access relationship; integration hub.
- AC3 Every predicate has volatility+strategy+directness (SIG-ONTO-067).
- AC4 Every technology family has -unspecified leaf (SIG-ONTO-020/054).
- AC5 No vendor name in any schema identifier (P7).
- AC6 Vocabularies at stable per-version IRIs (SIG-STORE-035).
- AC7 Phase-gate §51.3: CI green incl gen gate; req IDs in PR; retires ontology-churn risk.
- Counts SIG-ONTO-052/052a/060 asserted vs artifact; each tech: distinguishing criterion + evidence signature + salience L/M/H/C.

## Invariants
- P7 capability before vendor; no vendor name in identifiers.
- §3.1 every entity identity; every edge closed-catalog type.
- §0.7 Part VIII: no plate/trip/per-person column; Person tightly constrained.
- SKOS slugs stable forever; retirement = status:retired + superseded_by.

## Plan (Phase 1)
- Layout: ontology/src/ontology/schema/*.yaml (LinkML source of truth); ontology/vocab/*.yaml (SKOS term source); ontology/generated/{sql,jsonschema,owl,pydantic,docs,skos} (committed generated artifacts, outside src => not linted).
- Generators driven by CLI `sig-ontology generate` -> LinkML gen-* + bespoke SKOS(Turtle via rdflib)/predicate-registry/crosswalk. Wire into `make gen` (after export).
- Determinism: LinkML generators embed metadata/version/timestamp -> post-process to strip; run gen twice in CI-like check to confirm byte-identical.
- Data-driven vocab: term lists as YAML (counts asserted by tests). Predicate registry rows as YAML.
- Tests in tests/ontology/ (unit + generalization/) and tests/unit for gate.

## Test matrix (Phase 1.4)
- AC1: test verify-gen semantics — generate to temp, assert equals committed (tests/ontology/test_generation_gate.py) + make verify-gen.
- AC2: tests/ontology/generalization/ — 5 scenarios each assert construct expressible against generated JSON Schema / schema model.
- AC3: test every predicate registry row has volatility_class, resolution_strategy, directness row.
- AC4: test every technology family has an -unspecified leaf.
- AC5: test no vendor name (Flock/Motorola/Vigilant/Rekor/Axon/Genetec/Clearview/Fusus/ShotSpotter/SoundThinking/Cellebrite/...) appears in any schema/vocab identifier (slug/name/class/slot).
- AC6: test SKOS concept schemes carry stable per-version IRI (versionIRI pattern) + immutability marker.
- counts: test 14 domains / 36 families / 104 technologies / ~45 capabilities; each tech has distinguishing_criterion + evidence_signature + salience in {L,M,H,C}.
- entities: test all 23 §11 entities + [NEW] present as LinkML classes; all §12 edge types present; prohibited edges absent; no plate/trip/per-person slot; Person constrained.

## Determinism findings (de-risk)
- linkml 1.11.1 installed (aged 2026-05-20). generators present.
- gen-json-schema / gen-pydantic / gen-sqltables / gen-doc: byte-deterministic, no timestamps. OK.
- gen-owl / gen-shacl (RDF): NONDETERMINISTIC ordering -> canonicalize via rdflib.compare.to_canonical_graph + sorted N-Triples => byte-identical across runs. Emit .nt canonical artifacts for OWL + SHACL.
- pylock.toml regenerated after adding linkml (make export).

## Architecture (final)
- LinkML schema source: ontology/src/ontology/schema/ (sig.yaml main + entities.yaml + edges.yaml + enums structural). Single source for entities(§11)+edges(§12)+structural enums.
- Controlled vocab term lists: ontology/vocab/*.yaml (SKOS source of truth per §13 l.2153): technology.yaml(14/36/104), capability.yaml(~45), predicates.yaml(registry rows), crosswalks.yaml. i18n labels inline.
- Generated artifacts committed under ontology/generated/{jsonschema,pydantic,owl,shacl,sqlddl,docs,skos,registry} (outside src => not linted/typechecked/shipped).
- CLI `sig-ontology generate [--check]`; make gen calls it after export.
- Large tech/capability enums bound in LinkML as dynamic enums by concept-scheme IRI; full expansion lives in SKOS artifact. Structural enums (scopes/tracks/statuses/R-D-I-C-W/roles) inline in LinkML.
